code.purpose: Terminal text in wells and verdict bars. Anek at 90%, tabular.

document.purpose: Text inside the depicted Word file only.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Exponential ease out for every load animation and state change.

motion.name: ease-strike

motion.name: load-dots
motion.purpose: The three dots under "stand" scale in from 0.3.

motion.name: load-run
motion.value: output lines 220ms at 180ms + step x 130ms; strike 940ms; insertion and change bar 1180ms; balloon 1340ms

motion.name: scroll-reveal
motion.purpose: Benchmark bars draw, fact dots seat, the changed paragraph lifts, strikes draw, verdicts slide 24px in. Linear, bound to scroll.

motion.name: scroll-edge
motion.purpose: The well edge shade lifts as a phone well scrolls to its end. Kept under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced
motion.purpose: All animations and transitions off; the resting style is the end state.

components.css: :host{--ground:#e5e2dc;--well:#f3f1ed;--surface:#fdfcfa;--sheet:#fff;--ink:#23201d;--ink-hover:#3a3631;--muted:#48423b;--quiet:#5f584f;--bar:#23201d;--on-bar:#e5e2dc;--on-bar-quiet:rgba(229,226,220,.72);--on-bar-line:rgba(229,226,220,.45);--on-bar-fill:rgba(229,226,220,.09);--groove:#dcd8d1;--range:rgba(56,44,30,.2);--range-end:rgba(56,44,30,.5);--line:rgba(56,44,30,.3);--line-strong:rgba(35,32,29,.6);--doc-ink:#23201d;--ease:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);--shadow-bar:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14), 0 1px 1px rgba(35, 32, 29, 0.2), 0 4px 10px -4px rgba(35, 32, 29, 0.4), 0 24px 44px -24px rgba(40, 28, 16, 0.4);--shadow-key:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55), 0 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3), 0 3px 8px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);--shadow-page:inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff, 0 1px 2px rgba(56, 44, 30, 0.1), 0 2px 6px -2px rgba(56, 44, 30, 0.1), 0 22px 44px -24px rgba(56, 44, 30, 0.34);--set-in:inset 0 1px 3px rgba(56, 44, 30, 0.14), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);--font:'Anek Latin','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif} .ds-p{font:480 16px/24px var(--font);background:var(--ground);padding:16px} .ds-link{display:inline-block;padding:10px 0;margin:-10px 0;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-thickness:1px;text-decoration-color:var(--line);text-underline-offset:5px;transition:text-decoration-color 140ms var(--ease)} .ds-link:hover{text-decoration-color:var(--line-strong)} .ds-link:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ink);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:4px}

narrative.overview:
The page is stetdoc's mark, the proofreader's stet, built at the scale of the screen. The bar is a full-bleed graphite plane, and stetdoc's own words are reversed out of it: the claim "Let it stand.", the install command, every verdict, the benchmark times, and the closing install section. The three dots are graphite discs on the concrete: they hang once under the word "stand" and they hold the three facts of the benchmark. Everything else sits on Clauseo's warm concrete as planes, wells and one white sheet.

The world is inherited. Ground, planes, ink tones, depth recipes and the brick comma are Clauseo's design system, unchanged. stetdoc adds one material, the stet bar, and a small grammar around it: terminal text set into wells in Anek at 90% width, a depicted Word file as a white turned page, tracked changes drawn in ink, and motion that plays once on load or is driven by the scroll and then stops. Night is the same concrete with the light gone, chosen by `prefers-color-scheme`. At night the mark turns light, so every bar turns light with it and its words turn dark.

Density is low and type is large. The page is long, with wide gaps between parts, and each part pairs a short argument with the real artifact: a terminal run, a Word dialog, a paragraph stack, a benchmark table.
keyCharacteristics: One material carries stetdoc's voice: the graphite bar, at every scale from a 20px key to the full-bleed h1.
The stet mark's dots are structure, never decoration: under "stand" once, and on the three facts.
Anek Latin is the only interface family, and width carries the voice (125%, 116%, 104%, 90%).
Depth comes from planes, a top-edge highlight and warm-brown shadows. No glass, blur, glow, gradients or outlined boxes.
Tracked-change marks are drawn in ink, never in red or green.
Motion is CSS only: one load moment, scroll-driven reveals, then stillness.

rules.name: The One Brick Rule
rules.body: Brick appears only on Clauseo's comma. It is never a fill, a state, an accent or a tracked-change colour.

rules.name: The Ink Marks Rule
rules.body: Deletions, insertions, change bars and strikes are drawn in `doc-ink` or `ink`. A tracked change on this page is never red or green.

rules.name: The Bar Inverts Rule
rules.body: Whatever sits on a bar takes the bar's inverse: concrete words, concrete keys, concrete-tinted fills. Inside the closing bar the install plate inverts too, a concrete plate with a graphite key.

rules.name: The Width Carries Voice Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from Anek's width axis as much as its size. Do not add a second family to make a voice.

rules.name: The Depicted Document Rule
rules.body: The serif belongs to the Word file being depicted, the sheet and the bytes stack. It never sets the page's own words.

rules.name: The Narrow Terminal Rule
rules.body: Anything a terminal or stetdoc prints is Anek at 90% with tabular figures, including commands quoted in running text, which take 580 weight and no box.

rules.name: The Phone Mark Rule
rules.body: On a phone the three fact dots line up as one strip at the head of the facts, as the mark draws them, rather than splitting one per figure.

rules.name: The Well Scrolls, Not the Page Rule
rules.body: On phones long terminal lines never wrap and never push the page sideways. They scroll inside their well, and a right-edge shade says there is more.

rules.name: The Planes Not Lines Rule
rules.body: Separation comes from a plane's height or a 1px inset hairline, never from an outlined box or a hard rule.

rules.name: The Lift Means Changed Rule
rules.body: In the bytes stack the changed paragraph alone is raised; locked paragraphs stay flat. Height marks what stetdoc touched.

dos: **Do** put stetdoc's own words on a graphite bar (`bar` with `on-bar` text and the bar shadow): claims, commands, verdicts, results.
**Do** use the mark's dots only where the mark would put them: hanging under a bar, or holding exactly three items.
**Do** set terminal output and commands in Anek at 90% width with tabular figures, inside a set-in well.
**Do** draw tracked changes in ink: a 1.5px strike, a 1.5px underline, a 2px change bar.
**Do** keep every motion either a single load moment or driven by the scroll, with the resting style as the end state.
**Do** give every key, tab and link a 44px target.
donts: **Don't** use brick anywhere except Clauseo's comma.
**Don't** colour tracked changes red or green.
**Don't** add a monospace or a second sans; Anek's width axis is the range.
**Don't** use the serif outside the depicted Word file.
**Don't** separate with outlined boxes or hard rules; use planes and 1px inset hairlines.
**Don't** use glass, blur, glow or gradients.
**Don't** make the page scroll sideways on a phone; long terminal lines scroll inside their well.
